site.description: ANZ puts AI into day-to-day operations — computer vision, language and conversational AI, AI for education, and predictive analytics.

statement.title: Real engineers, real systems, measurable outcomes.
statement.body: We do not sell demo models. Every project starts from one concrete business metric, proves itself on a narrow pilot, and only then goes into the systems you already run — and we stay on to watch quality after handover.

features.title: Where we work
features.description: We go deep in a handful of AI domains rather than taking on everything — deep enough to ship into real systems.

vision.title: Computer vision
vision.description: Detects people, vehicles, objects and unusual behaviour in camera feeds. Applied to security monitoring, access control and production-line inspection.

education.title: AI for education
education.description: Personalised learning paths, automated grading and feedback, per-learner progress tracking. Flagship product: AI Mentor.

conversational.title: Language and assistants
conversational.description: Assistants grounded in internal documentation, text classification and summarisation, automated customer support.

generative.title: Generative AI
generative.description: Content generation, summarisation and knowledge extraction over your own data, with traceable sources.

document.title: Document intelligence
document.description: Extracts structured data from invoices, contracts and scanned forms, replacing manual data entry.

predictive.title: Analytics and forecasting
predictive.description: Demand forecasting, anomaly detection and early risk warnings built on your historical data.

howItWorks.title: From idea to a system in production
howItWorks.description: We prove the value with numbers before you commit to a large investment.

discovery.title: Scope the problem and the data
discovery.description: Clarify the business goal, assess the data you already hold, and agree on success metrics up front.

pilot.title: Build a working pilot
pilot.description: A functioning proof of concept within 4–6 weeks on a narrow scope, measured against the metrics we agreed.

rollout.title: Deploy and operate
rollout.description: Integrate with your existing systems, monitor model quality, and retrain on a schedule as the data shifts.

team.title: The specialists behind your project
team.description: AI engineers and researchers who have taken systems into production, involved directly from the first assessment through to handover.

testimonials.title: Working with ANZ
testimonials.description: Feedback from the teams who took our systems into real operation.

insights.title: Writing from the team
insights.description: Engineering notes and lessons from the AI projects we have shipped.

contact.title: Start with your problem
contact.description: Describe what you're up against and we'll get back to you within one business day.
